name: jevqueue
description: A decision queue in front of your agent's tools. Before a tool runs, a decision model is asked whether it should, and the call is refused when the answer is no.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Optional. With it, decisions come from Jev, the hosted System One model. Without it, the queue runs the offline rules baseline, which needs no credential and no network.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: enforce refuses a tool call the decision layer says should not run. advisory reports the same verdicts but never blocks. Defaults to enforce.

confidence_floor.title: Confidence floor
confidence_floor.description: Below this routing confidence the step is delegated rather than gated. An undecided decision is allowed, because a gate that refuses on doubt is a wall.
